reading.title: Supporting Black-Owned Businesses and Entrepreneurs
reading.passage:
Social media influencers have redefined modern marketing. By leveraging digital platforms, influencers construct unique personal brands that resonate with specific target audiences. While early social media personalities primarily focused on content creation, modern influencers increasingly operate as full-scale entrepreneurs.

Entrepreneurs are people who identify opportunities, take on the risks of a business, and organize resources to establish ventures. Influencers who start their own business certainly fall under this category. Their established follower base provides a built-in customer network, significantly lowering traditional customer acquisition costs and paving the way to scale-up their operations quickly.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the text?

choices.a: Black-owned businesses are systematically prevented from accelerating
choices.b: Communicating local role models to help Black-owned businesses
choices.c: Ideas proposed to enhance Black-owned businesses
choices.d: The vital necessity of venture capital for minority startups

questions.explanation: The passage outlines numbered, actionable recommendations—specifically authentic communication and improved bank financing—aimed at supporting and scaling Black-owned businesses.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the real driver for businesses to grow from small to medium and medium to big?
questions.explanation: The text states that bank finance is 'the main act' and 'the real driver for getting from small to medium, and medium to big.'

questions.question: What is the best title for this passage?

choices.a: Effective Ways to Support Black Entrepreneurs
choices.b: The Crucial Role of Venture Capital in Startup Growth
choices.c: Overcoming Racial Barriers in Corporate Presentations
choices.d: Navigating Commercial Bank Loans for Small Enterprises

questions.explanation: The passage provides numbered recommendations focused directly on addressing the genuine needs of Black business owners, covering culturally attuned communication and access to essential bank financing.

questions.question: What is the tone of the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage maintains a neutral, practical, and informative delivery of recommendations.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the passage?
questions.explanation: Informative texts aim primarily to provide objective details rather than persuade or sell.

questions.question: It can be inferred from the passage that...

choices.a: overcoming economic hardship inherently equips a speaker to understand racial business barriers
choices.b: traditional bank loans are more critical than venture capital for scaling most businesses
choices.c: venture capital provides the most dependable funding route for minority-owned startups
choices.d: Black entrepreneurs should prioritize venture capital pitches over seeking commercial loans

questions.explanation: Paragraph 3 identifies bank finance as the primary driver for expanding businesses from small to large, while labeling venture capital an unlikely side show.

questions.question: The following statements are TRUE according to the text EXCEPT _____.

choices.a: Venture capital serves as the primary and most dependable catalyst for scaling Black-owned businesses.
choices.b: The white speaker caused unintended offense by assuming his past poverty mirrored the struggles of Black business owners.
choices.c: Securing venture capital funding is statistically improbable for the vast majority of pitch applicants.
choices.d: Access to commercial loans and bank credit represents a more significant growth driver than venture capital.

questions.explanation: The passage states that bank finance, not venture capital, is the real driver for scaling businesses, describing the focus on venture capital as a diversion.

reading.title: Reading Text for Questions 1-10
reading.passage:
What is the most important part of our environment? Is it the land we walk on, the air we breathe, or the water we drink? It turns out that no single feature is more significant than the others are. The environment is made up of interactive systems, each as crucial as the next. There are five main systems, or spheres, on Earth: the geosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, and biosphere.

The geosphere consists of the interior and surface of Earth, both of which are made up of rocks. The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding Earth. The hydrosphere is composed of all the liquid water on Earth, while the cryosphere contains all the frozen water. Finally, the biosphere, a global ecosystem that encompasses all the living things on Earth, is the fifth system. Because these systems are interconnected, what affects one can affect another.

questions.question: According to the passage, which feature of Earth is considered the most significant?

choices.d: No single feature is more significant than the others

questions.explanation: The text states directly that 'no single feature is more significant than the others are' and that each plays a vital role in Earth's system.

questions.question: The paragraph following the passage will most likely discuss
questions.explanation: The text lists Earth's five major spheres sequentially, making the next sphere, the atmosphere, the logical topic for the subsequent paragraph.

reading.passage:

questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 defines globalization, illustrates it through cultural and consumer examples, and describes how it connects different parts of the world.

questions.question: From the passage, it can be inferred that the characteristics of influencers include _____.

choices.a: connecting with online audiences, shaping follower behavior, and persuading people to purchase products

reading.title: Reading Text for Questions 11-20
reading.passage:
Laws of physics limit the maximum efficiency of traditional silicon solar cells to around 29%. To surpass this limit, scientists are developing tandem solar cells that combine silicon with new materials such as perovskites. However, integrating these materials efficiently requires advanced conductive layers.

Researchers from the Graphene Flagship initiative and the University of Rome Tor Vergata have demonstrated that incorporating graphene and related two-dimensional materials into perovskite-silicon tandem cells can dramatically boost energy conversion efficiency. Aldo di Carlo, lead author, stated this paves the way towards breaking the 30% efficiency barrier. The application of graphene was recognized as a priority since the start of the Graphene Flagship, aligning strongly with Sustainable Development Goals.

questions.explanation: The passage highlights the technological limitations of silicon and perovskites before introducing graphene as the breakthrough solution for solar cells.

reading.title: Reading Text for Questions 41-50
reading.passage:
Laws of physics limit the maximum efficiency of traditional silicon solar cells to around 29%. To surpass this limit, scientists are developing tandem solar cells that combine silicon with new materials such as perovskites. However, integrating these materials efficiently requires advanced conductive layers.

Researchers from the Graphene Flagship initiative and the University of Rome Tor Vergata have demonstrated that incorporating graphene and related two-dimensional materials into perovskite-silicon tandem cells can dramatically boost energy conversion efficiency. Aldo di Carlo, lead author, stated this paves the way towards breaking the 30% efficiency barrier. The application of graphene was recognized as a priority since the start of the Graphene Flagship, aligning strongly with Sustainable Development Goals.

grammar.question: Successful businesses should acknowledge that teenage customers are not identical than diverse.
grammar.explanation: Correlative conjunction error. Replace 'than' with 'but' to complete the 'not... but' construction.

grammar.question: _______ in the Poetic Edda and the sagas, or heroic epics, of Iceland, the Anglo-Saxon Beowulf, and the German Song of Hildebrand, the pre-Christian literature of Europe belonged to an oral tradition.
grammar.explanation: Past participle 'Reflected' functions as a participial adjective modifying the subject 'pre-Christian literature'.

grammar.question: Such energy storage systems could deliver full electric power about 80 percent of the time, which is comparable to the performance of conventional power plants, the researchers says.
grammar.explanation: Plural subject 'the researchers' requires plural verb 'say', not singular 'says'.

grammar.question: By virtue of education and experience, architects hone the ability to devise creative spatial configurations to address real-world problems. The fact that architects are trained to design not just for the present, but for the future ways in which buildings may be used.
grammar.explanation: Sentence fragment error. Remove 'The fact that' to provide an independent clause with a main verb.

grammar.question: Eating most at breakfast instead of dinner could prevent obesity and high blood sugar.
grammar.explanation: Determiner error. Replace superlative 'most' with 'the most' or adverbial form.

grammar.question: Many newer disciplines have emerged from Biochemistry such as Enzymology, Endocrinology, Clinical Biochemistry, and Molecular Biochemistry. In contrast with these branches, certain specialties such as Agricultural Biochemistry and Pharmacological Biochemistry have also come up.
grammar.explanation: Transition error. Replace 'In contrast with' with an additive transition like 'In addition to'.

grammar.question: The catharsis in Aristotle's tragedy are brought about by witnessing some disastrous and moving change in the fortunes of the drama's protagonist (Aristotle recognized that the change might not be disastrous, but felt this was the kind shown in the best tragedies—Oedipus at Colonus).
grammar.explanation: Subject-verb agreement error. Replace plural 'are' with singular 'is' to match head noun 'catharsis'.

grammar.question: Big dogs are often mismatched from weak seniors because an elderly dog owner said old people need dogs.
grammar.explanation: Preposition error. Replace 'from' with 'with' following 'mismatched'.

grammar.question: Kornberg and his colleagues were discovered enzymes responsible for DNA repair and rearrangement.
grammar.explanation: Voice error. Remove auxiliary 'were' to form active voice past simple 'discovered'.

grammar.question: The second and most complex step of extract the actual kaon decay amplitudes was performed at the National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center (NERSC), a DOE Office of Science user facility at DOE's Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory.
grammar.explanation: Gerund error. Replace base verb 'extract' with gerund 'extracting' after preposition 'of'.

grammar.question: Teachers' unions will be obliged to protects teacher rights such as setting standards on how long a teacher can work and what duties they may undertake.
grammar.explanation: Infinitive error. Replace third-person singular 'protects' with base form 'protect' after 'to'.

grammar.question: Exactly a year on from the discovery that a cheap steroid drug prevented Covid deaths, researchers say they have found other life-saving therapy.
grammar.explanation: Determiner error. Replace 'other' with 'another' before singular countable noun 'therapy'.

grammar.question: Hence in the earlier book, Plato advocates an open and strict censorship of poetry, introduced certain charges hitherto unelaborated.
grammar.explanation: Participle error. Replace past tense 'introduced' with present participle 'introducing' to modify the main clause.

grammar.question: While kids are watching television, they______ to many ads of foods and drinks.
grammar.explanation: Plural pronoun 'they' requires the simple present passive 'are exposed' to denote a general recurring condition.

grammar.question: __________ changes in genetic diversity, population bottlenecks and inbreeding is vital in the face of declining populations and environmental change, given their effects on population resilience, adaptive potential and fitness.
grammar.explanation: Gerund 'Identifying' functions as the singular subject governing the main verb 'is'.

grammar.question: Scientists believe Earth will _____ more extreme, disastrous weather as the effect of climate change.
grammar.explanation: Modal auxiliary 'will' takes a bare infinitive 'experience'.

grammar.question: If the employees who work from home do not perform, they will either be loose the privilege of working at home or being fired.
grammar.explanation: Word form error. Replace 'be loose' with base verb 'lose' after auxiliary 'will'.

grammar.question: There are two ways governments have managed to create demand and spur growth. The first is called assistance programs and another means governments have of creating demand and spurring growth is via big-ticket infrastructure projects.
grammar.explanation: Pronoun error. Replace 'another' with 'the other' when referring to the second of two items.

grammar.question: We have social _____ that didn't exist nine decades ago. Fortunately, that's true even for developing countries.
grammar.explanation: Standard compound noun phrase is 'safety nets'.

grammar.question: The tragic drama of Aristotle's day was not the same as that of the fifth century, and to a certain extent his work ________ as a historical study of a genre that no longer existed rather than as a description of a living art form.
grammar.explanation: Passive modal construction requires 'must be' followed by past participle 'construed'.

grammar.question: Parents should not assume that all cartoons are acceptable and appropriate because little contain violence.
grammar.explanation: Countable referent 'cartoons' requires quantifier 'few', not non-count quantifier 'little'.

grammar.question: When Kornberg was a medical student, he _____ a research indicating that high levels of bilirubin frequently occurred as a result of a reduced capacity to excrete it.
grammar.explanation: Past time clause requires simple past 'conducted' for a completed action.

grammar.question: The analytical method Aristotle used is not _______ to a literary study and is sometimes too artificial or formula-prone in its conclusions.
grammar.explanation: Predicate adjective 'suited' requires the adverb 'completely' for modification.

grammar.question: Mario Bross _____ turtles like he always did, though better than ever thanks to new technology of Nintendo Switch.
grammar.explanation: Standard adverb placement puts 'just' between the auxiliary 'is' and the main verb 'jumping', followed by the preposition 'on'.

grammar.question: Green plants depend on only four simple inputs—carbon dioxide, water, mineral salts, and sunlight—for their entire growth process, a requirement that stands in contrast from the nutritional needs of animals.
grammar.explanation: Preposition idiom error. Replace 'contrast from' with 'contrast to' or 'contrast with'.

grammar.question: Today, grain ___ a staple food of the Maasai, but they still drink large quantities of milk.
grammar.explanation: Uncountable singular noun 'grain' with time marker 'Today' requires present perfect singular 'has become'.

grammar.question: Neither animal welfare science nor animal ethics philosophy ___ devoted much attention to human activities that harm animals in direct but unintended ways.
grammar.explanation: Subjects joined by 'neither... nor' take verb agreement from the closer subject 'animal ethics philosophy', which is singular.

grammar.question: I believe that if ASEAN continued to maintain this level of economic growth, you will be able to solidify your global status further, he said.
grammar.explanation: Tense consistency error in first conditional. Replace past tense 'continued' with present tense 'continues' to match 'will be able'.

grammar.question: The Filtration Test's application is far more controversial than the pattern and abstraction test due the equivocations relating to the distinction between ideas and expressions in music.
grammar.explanation: Preposition error. Replace 'due' with 'due to' before noun phrase.

grammar.question: Humans ___ with hormones to handle daily and long-term stresses, such as high-stakes exams or divorce in the family.
grammar.explanation: Plural subject 'Humans' requires the plural passive construction 'are equipped'.

grammar.question: The patient ________ by the doctor when the power went out.
